title: Recovery, delivery leases and journal model
summary: W2 and E2 store hex-encoded field bytes, preserving pipes. S re-arms, K leases/increments attempts, R receives, D dead-letters exhausted events, C records completed mailbox read (mock in demo). Historic dev4 W/E replay is supported. A later watch must not be blocked by an undeliverable event.
invariants: Result payload never enters the nudge; W2/E2 journal fields are hex-encoded.
A dead-lettered event stays dead on replay and cannot block later events.
Atomic/crash-consistent storage requires qualified production backend.

provenance.claim: dev4 accepted native core tests only
Dev5 candidate and explicit qualification boundary
